[[The Drought]] is a powerful servant of [[Abaddon]] formed from the land that seeks to corrupt and tame the [[Elon]] to its will and eventually consume it. Afterwards, it plans on heading to [[Istan]] to do the same to the water there. Residing at the [[Mahnkelon Waterworks]], it creates dozens of [[Droughtling]]s to protect itself, and grows more powerful the more water it consumes.

== Notes ==
* The Drought is a non-demonic servant of [[Abaddon]]; [[Lightbringer's Gaze]] is useless against it.
* The following tactics are effective in dealing with the Drought:
** [[Winter]] will negate the bonuses from earth damage.
** The Drought can be [[shutdown]] by [[daze]], [[Power Block]] or [[knock down]]s. 
** [[Pain Inverter]] is even more effective using a [[minion master]] to exploit Sandstorm's [[area of effect]] damage — the more [[minion]]s that get hit, the more damage there is to invert.
** [[Protective Spirit]] is effective, since the Drought almost always hits for over 200 damage.
** [[Shelter]] provides enough [[party]]-wide protection to kill the Drought using the [[Pain Inverter]] strategy (it generally will not survive more than one Sandstorm).
